samples.xml_description:
<module id="div_8bit">
    <description>A simplified radix-2 divider on 8-bit signed or unsigned integers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">Indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">The dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">The divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">A valid operation request is present.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">The result is valid and ready.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">The 16-bit output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">Idle state for the FSM.</parameter>
        <parameter id="LOAD">Load state for loading inputs.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIVIDE">Divide state for performing division.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DONE">Done state for completing division.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <signal id="reg_dividend" width_description="[7:0]" type="register"></signal>
        <signal id="reg_divisor" width_description="[7:0]" type="register"></signal>
        <signal id="neg_divisor" width_description="[8:0]" type="register"></signal>
        <signal id="sr" width_description="[16:0]" type="register"></signal>
        <signal id="cnt" width_description="[3:0]" type="register"></signal>
        <signal id="start_cnt" type="register"></signal>
        <signal id="res_valid_reg" type="register"></signal>
        
        // Internal signals
        <signal id="sub_result" width_description="[9:0]"></signal>
        <signal id="mux_out" width_description="[9:0]"></signal>
        <signal id="carry_in" type="wire"></signal>
        
        // Assignments
        <assign id="carry_in" value="~(|SR[16:9]) & sr[8];"/>
        
        // Combinational logic for MUX
        <always_comb>
            case ({|SR[16:9], sr[8]})
                2'b00: mux_out = {1'b0, sr[16:9]};
                2'b01: mux_out = sub_result;
                2'b10: mux_out = {1'b1, sr[16:9]};
                2'b11: mux_out = sub_result;
            endcase
        end
        
        // Sequential logic
        <always_ff @(posedge clk or posedge rst)>
            if (rst) begin
                reg_dividend <= 8'h00;
                reg_divisor <= 8'h00;
                neg_divisor <= 9'h000;
                sr <= 17'h00000;
                cnt <= 4'h0;
                start_cnt <= 1'b0;
                res_valid_reg <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                if (opn_valid && !res_valid_reg) begin
                    reg_dividend <= dividend;
                    reg_divisor <= divisor;
                    neg_divisor <= ~{sign ? dividend[7] : 1'b0, divisor} + 1;
                    sr <= {{8{1'b0}}, dividend, 1'b0};
                    cnt <= 4'd1;
                    start_cnt <= 1'b1;
                end else if (start_cnt) begin
                    if (&cnt) begin
                        cnt <= 4'h0;
                        start_cnt <= 1'b0;
                        sr <= {mux_out[8:0], sr[7:0]};
                    end else begin
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                        sr <= {mux_out[8:0], sr[7:0]};
                    end
                end
                
                if (cnt == 4'd8) begin
                    res_valid_reg <= 1'b1;
                end else if (res_valid_reg && res_ready) begin
                    res_valid_reg <= 1'b0;
                end
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Implement the radix-2 divider functionality here.</implementation>
    <task>
        <step id="STEP_1">Define the parameters for the divider, including the states for the FSM and any other necessary variables.</step>
        <step id="STEP_2">Create sequential logic blocks to store the inputs and perform the division operation.</step>
        <step id="STEP_3">Use combinatorial logic to calculate the results and update the shift register accordingly.</step>
        <step id="STEP_4">Manage the validity of the result and ensure proper timing constraints are met.</step>
    </task>
</module>
